description: Pub. 544 (2025), nonrecaptured § 1231 losses: a $2,000 net § 1231 gain in 2025 with $700 of net § 1231 loss left from 2020–2024 ($2,500 in 2022 less the $1,800 gain of 2024): '$700 Gain treated as ordinary income', '$1,300 Gain treated as long-term capital gain' (Form 4797 lines 8, 9 and 12).
